blocks.prompt:
1 Design Thinking looks at problems from different angles. Explain its five steps (Empathize, Define, Ideate, Prototype, Test) using the book's example of designing a new school bag. (8 marks)
(Design Thinking masail ko mukhtalif zawiyon se dekhti hai. Is ke paanch qadam (Empathize, Define, Ideate, Prototype, Test) kitab ki naye school bag wali misal se samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Design Thinking aisa tareeqa hai jo masail ko mukhtalif zawiyon se dekhta hai; seedha hal ki taraf jane ke bajaye pehle masla gehrai se samajhta hai.

1. Empathize: khud ko doosre ki jagah rakh kar us ke ehsasat, zarooratein aur mushkilat samajhna. Bag misal: students se poochna ke unhein apne mojooda bag mein kya pasand aur kya na-pasand hai.

2. Define: maloomat jama kar ke masla wazeh likhna. Bag misal: 'Students ko halka, mazboot aur kushada bag chahiye jo uthane mein aaram deh ho'.

3. Ideate: har mumkin hal ka brainstorm, mukammal hone ki fikr ke baghair. Bag misal: aaram ke liye extra padding wala bag, ya aise khane jin se kitabein aur saman tarteeb se rahein.

4. Prototype: khayal ka saada namoona jo jaldi ban sake. Bag misal: gatte, kapre ya kaghaz ka saada model jo dikhaye bag kaisa lagega.

5. Test: prototype check karna ke theek kaam karta hai. Bag misal: students se bag istemal karwa kar raye lena; un ki raye par behtari karte rehna jab tak masla hal karne wala aakhri product na ban jaye.

blocks.prompt:
2 A good business plan has several key parts. Explain the Executive Summary, Business Description, Market Analysis, Organization and Management, Products or Services, Marketing and Sales Strategy and Financial Plan, giving an example of each from the book. (8 marks)
(Achhe business plan ke kai ahem hisse hote hain. Executive Summary, Business Description, Market Analysis, Organization and Management, Products or Services, Marketing and Sales Strategy aur Financial Plan ko kitab ki aik aik misal ke saath samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Business plan aisa document hai jo kaarobari khayal, use kamyab banane ka mansooba aur maqasid tak pohanchne ke qadam bayan karta hai.

1. Executive Summary: kaarobari khayal ka mukhtasar jaiza: kaarobar kya karta hai, maqasid aur unhein hasil karne ka tareeqa; plan ke ahem tareen nukaat.

2. Business Description: kaarobar kis bare mein hai: products ya services, target customers aur inferadiyat. Misal: mohalle mein lemonade stand; ya 'Hamara chai dhaba taaza chai ... local bazaar ke qareeb.'

3. Market Analysis: market ki samajh: mumkina customers, un ki zarooratein aur muqabil. Misal: pet-sitting ke liye ilaqe mein pet owners ki tadad aur doosri services.

4. Organization and Management: kaarobar ki tanzeem, team members aur kirdar. Misal: school club ke president, secretary aur doosre ohde.

5. Products or Services: kya bech rahe hain, khoobiyan aur faide. Misal: tuition ke sabaq students ke grades kaise behtar karenge.

6. Marketing and Sales Strategy: customers kaise layenge aur rakhenge; marketing ke tareeqe aur sales tactics. Misal: crafts kaarobar ka social media aur maqami mele.

7. Financial Plan: maali maqasid aur un ka hasool; budget, funding ki zaroorat aur mutawaqqa aamdani. Misal: supplies ke liye $100 chahiye to batayein kaise jama karenge aur kitna kamane ki umeed hai.

book_ref.quote: A good business plan usually has several key parts

blocks.prompt:
3 Digital tools make creating a business plan more accessible and efficient. (i) Explain how business plan software helps, with the book's online bookstore example. (ii) Explain how collaborative tools help a team, with the book's bakery example. (8 marks)
(Digital tools business plan banana aasan aur karkardag banate hain. (i) Kitab ki online bookstore misal se samjhayein ke business plan software kaise madad karta hai. (ii) Kitab ki bakery misal se samjhayein ke collaborative tools team ki kaise madad karte hain.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Business plan software: kai software business plan banana aasan karte hain. Yeh tarteeb wale templates, financial modeling features aur rehnumai dete hain jin se wazeh aur tafseeli plan banta hai.
Misal: chhota online bookstore shuru karne ke liye PlanGuru ya Enloop jaisa software le kar retail kaarobar ka template chunein. Software business overview aur market analysis jaise hisson ki rehnumai karta hai. Financial calculators mein inventory, website aur marketing ke kharche dalein; software andazan sales aur cash flow jaisi projections charts aur graphs ke saath banata hai. Is se investors ko plan dikhana ya funding ke liye darkhwast aasan hoti hai.

(ii) Collaborative tools: team ka mil kar kaam zaroori hai, khaas taur par partners ya mushiron ke saath. Collaborative tools kai logon ko aik waqt mein plan mein hissa dalne aur foran raye aur tarmeem ka platform dete hain.
Misal: aap dost ke saath bakery kholte hain; dost baking mein mahir hai aur aap operations sambhalte hain. Google Drive ya Dropbox Paper par dono aik hi document par aik saath kaam karte hain: partner products aur recipes likhta hai aur aap marketing plan aur financial forecast. Commenting aur suggestion modes asal text badle baghair raye ya tabdeeli ki tajweez dene dete hain, taake alag jagah hote hue bhi faisle mil kar hon. Version control tabdeeliyan track karta aur zaroorat par pichhle draft par wapas le jata hai.

book_ref.quote: Below, we discuss the software that can help you create your business plan

blocks.prompt:
4 Market research gathers data about the market in which a business operates. (i) Explain qualitative and quantitative research with the book's examples. (ii) Explain customer surveys and focus groups with the bakery examples. (8 marks)
(Market research us market ka data jama karti hai jis mein kaarobar chalta hai. (i) Qualitative aur quantitative research ko kitab ki misalon se samjhayein. (ii) Customer surveys aur focus groups ko bakery ki misalon se samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Market research us market ka data jama karne ka amal hai jis mein kaarobar chalta hai, taake customers ki zarooratein, pasand aur rawaiye aur muqabilon ki taqat aur kamzori samjhi ja sake.

(i) Qualitative research customers ki andaruni wajoohat, aara aur muharrikat samajhti hai. Yeh interviews, focus groups aur mushahide se ghair-adadi data jama karti hai. Misal: bakery kholne se pehle mumkina customers se pasandeeda bread aur pastries par gehri guftagu batati hai ke customers ko kya zyada azeez hai, jis se products aur ishtehari paigham bante hain.
Quantitative research adadi data jama karti hai jo naapa aur statistically parkha ja sake; yeh customers ke rawaiye mein patterns aur trends pehchanne ke liye mufeed hai. Misal: survey ke log kitni dafa coffee khareedte aur kitna dene ko tayyar hain, qeemat aur sales ka andaza lagane mein madad deta hai.

(ii) Customer surveys bari tadad mein customers se online, phone par ya aamne saamne maloomat jama karne ka taqatwar tool hain. Sawalon se pasand, rawaiye aur demographics ka data milta hai. Misal: bakery se pehle mohalle mein survey batata hai ke log kaun si cheezein chahte hain, kab khareedte hain aur kitna kharch karte hain, taake products aur auqat-e-kaar dhaale ja sakein.
Focus groups chhota aur mukhtalif logon ka group hai jo product, service ya concept par tafseeli guftagu karta hai taake customers ki aara aur rawaiye samjhe ja sakein. Misal: shurka bread aur pastries chakh kar pasand, na-pasand aur tajaweez batate hain, jo products behtar karne ke liye qeemti qualitative data hai.

book_ref.quote: This data can help you understand customer needs, preferences, and behaviors

rows: Adadi data, statistically parkha jata hai

blocks.prompt:
5 After gathering market data, the next step is to analyze it. Explain understanding trends and patterns, market segmentation, competitor analysis and predictive analysis, with the bakery examples, and say how they lead to data-driven decisions. (8 marks)
(Market data jama karne ke baad agla qadam is ka tajziya hai. Trends aur patterns, market segmentation, competitor analysis aur predictive analysis ko bakery ki misalon se samjhayein aur batayein ke yeh data-driven faislon tak kaise le jate hain.)
blocks.explanation:
Market data ke tajziye ka matlab hai maloomat dekh kar patterns, trends aur insights dhoondna jo kaarobari faislon ki rehnumai karein aur data ko mufeed strategies mein badlein.

1. Trends aur patterns: aik ahem maqsad trends aur patterns pehchanna hai. Misal: bakery survey batata hai ke zyada khareedari weekends par hoti hai, is liye weekends par marketing ya khaas promotions sales barha sakti hain.

2. Market segmentation: bari market ko umar, aamdani ya aadaton ki bunyad par chhote groups mein baantna. Misal: kam umar log meethi pastries aur bare umar wale whole-grain bread pasand karte hain; har group ke liye products aur marketing badalne se khushi aur sales barhti hain.

3. Competitor analysis: muqabilon ki taqat, kamzori, qeematon aur customer feedback ka mutaala taake kaarobar mukhtalif ban sake. Misal: qareeb ki bakery artisanal bread ke liye mashhoor ho to gourmet pastries ya mausami cakes shamil karein.

4. Predictive analysis: purane data se mustaqbil ke trends aur nataij ka andaza. Misal: kisi product ki demand musalsal barh rahi ho to andaza lagayein ke barhti rahegi aur paidawar barhayein ya menu wasee karein; is se khatra kam aur mauqe zyada hote hain.

Data-driven decisions: asal maqsad products chunne, qeemat rakhne aur marketing ke soche samjhe faisle hain. Misal: kamzor product band kar ke wasail kamyab products par lagaye jate hain.

book_ref.quote: This means reviewing the information to find patterns, trends, and insights

blocks.prompt:
6 Define revenue and profit. A shop sells 150 school bags at Rs. 600 each. Its costs are rent Rs. 20,000, salaries Rs. 25,000 and cost of goods Rs. 15,000. Find its revenue and profit. (8 marks)
(Revenue aur profit ki definition likhein. Dukaan 150 school bags Rs. 600 fi bag bechti hai. Kharche: kiraya Rs. 20,000, tankhwahein Rs. 25,000 aur maal ki qeemat Rs. 15,000. Revenue aur profit maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: Revenue cheezein ya services bech kar kul kamai hai. Profit kaarobar ke tamam kharche (kiraya, tankhwahein, maal ki qeemat) nikal kar bachne wali raqam hai. Pehle revenue = tadad x qeemat, phir kul kharche, phir profit = revenue - kharche.

book_ref.quote: Revenue is the total amount of money a business earns from selling goods or services

steps: Revenue = bags ki tadad x qeemat = 150 x 600 = Rs. 90,000
Kul kharche = kiraya + tankhwahein + maal = 20,000 + 25,000 + 15,000 = Rs. 60,000

blocks.prompt:
7 Explain investment and savings. A clothing store invests Rs. 80,000 in new inventory and sells it for Rs. 110,000. It also saves Rs. 12,000 every month for 12 months to buy a new machine. Find the profit on the investment and the total savings. (8 marks)
(Investment aur savings samjhayein. Kapron ka store Rs. 80,000 ka naya maal khareed kar Rs. 110,000 mein bechta hai. Woh nayi machine ke liye 12 mahine har mahine Rs. 12,000 bhi bachata hai. Investment par munafa aur kul bachat maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: Investment mustaqbil ke munafe ke liye kaarobar ya project mein raqam lagana hai; store ko umeed hai ke maal laagat se zyada mein bikega. Savings mustaqbil ki zarooraton, jaise naya saman, kaarobar barhana ya achanak kharche, ke liye alag rakha paisa hai. Is liye munafa = bechne ki raqam - lagai gayi raqam, aur bachat = mahana raqam x mahine.

book_ref.quote: it anticipates selling the items for a higher amount than the cost, thereby earning a profit

steps: Investment par munafa = bechne ki raqam - investment = 110,000 - 80,000 = Rs. 30,000
Kul bachat = mahana bachat x mahine = 12,000 x 12 = Rs. 144,000
blocks.final_answer: Investment par munafa = Rs. 30,000; aik saal ki bachat = Rs. 144,000

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab ki misal mein 'Rs. 10.000' chhapa hai; asal raqam Rs. 10,000 har mahina hai (Book correction). Is sawal mein raqam badal kar Rs. 12,000 rakhi gayi hai.

blocks.prompt:
8 Define loan and interest. A shop needs Rs. 250,000 for one year. Bank A charges 12% per year and Bank B charges 9% per year. Find the total repayment for each bank and how much the shop saves by choosing the lower rate. (8 marks)
(Loan aur interest ki definition likhein. Dukaan ko aik saal ke liye Rs. 250,000 chahiye. Bank A 12% salana aur Bank B 9% salana leta hai. Har bank ki kul wapsi aur kam rate chunne se bachat maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: Loan udhaar liya paisa hai (bank ya maali idare se) jo interest ke saath wapas karna hota hai. Interest udhaar ki qeemat hai, aam taur par loan ka percentage. Kul wapsi = loan + rate x loan; zyada rate ka matlab zyada wapsi.

book_ref.quote: Example: if a tea shop in Multan takes a loan of Rs. 100,000 at an interest rate of 10% per year

blocks.final_answer: Bank A: Rs. 280,000; Bank B: Rs. 272,500; Bank B se dukaan Rs. 7,500 bachati hai

blocks.prompt:
9 Define expenses and budget. A bakery's monthly budget is rent Rs. 150,000, ingredients Rs. 100,000, salaries Rs. 200,000 and utilities Rs. 50,000. Its actual expenses for the month come to Rs. 530,000. Find the total budget and say whether the bakery overspent or saved, and by how much. (8 marks)
(Expenses aur budget ki definition likhein. Bakery ka mahana budget: kiraya Rs. 150,000, ajza Rs. 100,000, tankhwahein Rs. 200,000 aur bijli paani Rs. 50,000. Mahine ke asal kharche Rs. 530,000 hue. Kul budget maloom karein aur batayein ke bakery ne zyada kharch kiya ya bachaya, aur kitna.)
blocks.explanation: Expenses woh kharche hain jo kaarobar chalane mein hote hain, jaise kiraya, bijli paani, tankhwahein aur khaam maal. Budget aisa mansooba hai jo kaarobar ke mukhtalif shobon ke liye zaroori raqam ka andaza lagata hai. Budget aur asal kharchon ka muqabla batata hai ke kaarobar zyada kharch kar raha hai ya bacha raha hai.

book_ref.quote: These can include rent, utilities, salaries, and the cost of raw materials

steps: Asal kharche = Rs. 530,000, jo budget se zyada hain
blocks.final_answer: Kul budget = Rs. 500,000; bakery ne Rs. 30,000 zyada kharch kiya

blocks.prompt:
10 Communication and storytelling help you express ideas and connect with others. (i) Define communication and explain three things that make it effective when presenting a project. (ii) Define storytelling and explain five tips to develop communication and storytelling skills. (8 marks)
(Communication aur storytelling khayalat batane aur logon se judne mein madad deti hain. (i) Communication ki definition likhein aur project pesh karte waqt ise mo'assar banane wali teen cheezein samjhayein. (ii) Storytelling ki definition likhein aur communication aur storytelling ki salahiyat barhane ki paanch tips samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Communication doosron ke saath maloomat, khayalat ya ehsasat ke tabadle ka amal hai. Yeh verbal (bolna ya likhna) ya non-verbal (ishare ya chehre ke taassurat) ho sakti hai. Achhi communication mein paigham wazeh pohanchana aur doosron ko tawajjuh se sunna shamil hai. Mahol ke tahaffuz par class project pesh karte hue mo'assar communication mein:
1. Wazeh bolna: aise bolna ke sab aasani se samjhein.
2. Achhi body language: ishare, nazar milana aur aitmaad se khare hona.
3. Sunna: audience ke sawalon ka jawab dena aur un ki raye par ghaur karna.

(ii) Storytelling alfaz, tasveeron aur jazbaat se aisi kahani banana hai jo sunne walon ko jor le; achhi kahani tawajjuh khenchti, mushkil khayalat aasan karti aur paigham yaad rakhne mein madad deti hai. Tips:
1. Baqaida mashq: jitna zyada bolenge aur kahaniyan sunayenge utna aitmaad barhega.
2. Audience ko jaanein: paigham classmates, teachers ya ghar walon ke mutabiq dhaalein.
3. Visual aids: tasveerein, diagrams aur props kahani ko dilchasp aur aasan banate hain.
4. Wazeh aur mukhtasar: ghair zaroori tafseel chhor kar asal paigham par tawajjuh.
5. Jazbaat dikhayein: awaz aur chehre se apne ehsasat zahir karein; is se baat asli aur qareeb lagti hai.

book_ref.quote: Good communication involves clearly conveying your message

blocks.prompt:
11 Collaboration and iteration help refine ideas and solutions. Define collaboration and iteration with one example of each from the book, and explain their importance using the community clean-up drive example. (8 marks)
(Collaboration aur iteration khayalat aur hal ko behtar banate hain. Collaboration aur iteration ki definition kitab ki aik aik misal ke saath likhein aur safai muhim ki misal se in ki ahmiyat samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Collaboration: jab do ya zyada log mushtarka maqsad ke liye mil kar kaam karein, khayalat, wasail aur koshishein share kar ke masail hal karein ya kuch naya banayein. Pakistan mein yeh group project ya mohalle ki taqreeb mein nazar aata hai. Misal: science exhibition ke model mein aik student diagram banata, doosra model banata aur teesra samjhata hai; mil kar woh akele se behtar project banate hain.

Iteration: matloob nateeje ke qareeb aane ke liye amal dohrana, feedback par tabdeeli aur behtari karte hue jab tak aakhri nateeja na mile (jaise khana pakate hue ajza badalna). Misal: class school event ka logo banati, raye leti, rang aur shaklein badalti, phir raye leti aur dohrati hai jab tak sab aakhri logo par razi na hon.

Ahmiyat: collaboration aur iteration behtar nataij aur doosron se seekhne mein madad dete hain. Collaboration ilm aur hunar jor kar mushkil masail hal karta hai; iteration kaam ko har qadam par behtar banati hai.
Safai muhim ki misal: log tay karte hain kahan se shuru karein aur kin jagahon par zyada tawajjuh chahiye. Kaam ke dauran pata chalta hai ke kuch kaam lambe hain ya mazeed razakar chahiye. Woh mansooba badalte (iterate) aur mil kar kaam jari rakhte (collaborate) hain jab tak poora ilaqa saaf na ho jaye.

book_ref.quote: Collaboration and iteration are important because they help you to produce better results and learn from others

blocks.prompt:
12 Innovation and creativity drive progress. (i) Define innovation and creativity with the book's Pakistani example of each. (ii) Explain four ways to foster innovation and creativity. (8 marks)
(Innovation aur creativity taraqqi ka zariya hain. (i) Innovation aur creativity ki definition kitab ki Pakistani misalon ke saath likhein. (ii) Innovation aur creativity barhane ke chaar tareeqe samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Innovation naye khayalat, products ya tareeqe banane ka amal hai jo numayan tabdeeli ya behtari layein. Yeh sirf bilkul nayi cheez ijaad karna nahi, mojooda cheezon ko behtar, tez ya zyada karkardag banana bhi hai. Misal: Pakistan mein mobile banking. Pehle logon ko bank jana parta tha jo waqt leta aur mushkil tha, khaas taur par dehi ilaqon mein; ab woh mobile phone se paisa bhejte, lete, bill dete aur banking ke kaam karte hain.
Creativity naye aur anokhe andaz mein sochne ki salahiyat hai, jis mein tasawwur se aam se hat kar khayalat paida kiye jate hain. Yeh sirf artists ya mojideen tak mehdood nahi, science, engineering, business aur taleem samet har shobe mein qeemti hai. Misal: maqami Pakistani brands creativity se aisi ishtehari muhim banate hain jo products ki tashheer ke saath logon se jazbati raabta jorti hai.

(ii) Innovation aur creativity barhane ke tareeqe:
1. Tajassus rakhein: hamesha sawal karein aur dekhein cheezein kaise kaam karti hain; tajassus innovation ka pehla qadam hai.
2. Khatra lein: nayi cheezein aazmane se na darein chahe pehli dafa kamyab na hon; bohat si kamyab innovations nakami se seekhne se aati hain.
3. Hat kar sochein: masail ko mukhtalif zawiyon se dekhein; behtareen hal woh ho sakta hai jo kisi ne na socha ho.
4. Mil kar kaam karein: doosron ke saath kaam naye khayalat jagata aur naye hal tak le jata hai.

book_ref.quote: Innovation is the process of developing new ideas, products, or methods that bring about significant change or improvement
